payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validator that inspects a raw candidate TCP-port list and returns an explicit invalid-result object without raising. Target input contract: the consuming Recipe supplies a step-local mapping inputs['ports'] that must be a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive. Booleans are not integers and are rejected; scalars, empty lists, null, missing keys and out-of-range values fail closed. The outer input contract admits the raw candidate shape (including absent/null/wrong-type) so the validator can inspect it; the inner validation implements the rule. Read the candidate with inputs.get('ports') or an explicit presence branch, never inputs['ports'], because absence is a valid invalid-result. Do not raise for malformed data; return {valid: false, ports: []} for any invalid candidate and {valid: true, ports: <original list>} only when every element is a valid integer in range. Missing and null remain distinct: an absent key yields valid=false with empty ports; an explicit null also yields valid=false. Validate all required fields before any access or arithmetic. Missing typed-runner support is a prerequisite: the target inputs['ports'] mapping and typed integer transport are a target interface, not guaranteed deployed runtime support; the selected Monty runner must preserve exact integer semantics and reject booleans before dispatch. No approval claims.
